content: Apache Arrow JS supports zero-copy typed-array-backed vectors via tableFromIPC/makeVector but ships ~163kb minified / ~43kb gzip; Flechette is a lighter zero-dependency alternative (~43kb min / ~14kb gzip) with the same zero-copy IPC decode semantics. For a fixed internal schema (dates + price-return + total-return + short-rate), a raw ArrayBuffer with a small custom header gives true zero-copy with zero parsing library at all.
